record.paper_title: Steinberg Groups for Jordan Pairs - An Introduction with Open Problems
record.original_question: Let (R, R_1) be a 3-graded root system, let V be a Jordan pair with a root grading by R, and let pi: St(V, R) -> PE(V) be the canonical homomorphism from the Steinberg group of the root graded Jordan pair to the projective elementary group, determined on generators by sending x_sigma(u) to exp_sigma(u). Assuming R is irreducible and has finite rank, find sufficient conditions under which Ker(pi) is central in St(V, R).

evidence.quote: There exists a group homomorphism π : St(V, R) → PE(V ), uniquely determined by π xσ (u) = expσ (u),
The problem here is: find sufficient conditions for Ker(π) to be central if R has finite rank.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(R, R_1)$ be a 3-graded root system, where $R$ is assumed to be irreducible and of finite rank. Let $V = (V^+, V^-)$ be a Jordan pair endowed with a root grading by $R$, and let $\mathrm{PE}(V)$ denote its projective elementary group, generated by the elementary automorphisms $\exp_\sigma(u)$ for $\sigma \in R_1$ and $u$ in the corresponding root space. Let $\mathrm{St}(V, R)$ denote the Steinberg group of the root-graded Jordan pair, given by generators $x_\sigma(u)$ (for $\sigma \in R_1$ and $u$ in the corresponding root space of $V$) subject to the standard Steinberg-type relations associated with the 3-graded root system and Jordan pair structure. Let
$$\pi : \mathrm{St}(V, R) \longrightarrow \mathrm{PE}(V)$$
be the canonical group homomorphism uniquely determined on generators by $\pi(x_\sigma(u)) = \exp_\sigma(u)$.

Determine sufficient conditions on $V$ and $R$ under which $\ker(\pi)$ is central in $\mathrm{St}(V, R)$ (equivalently, conditions under which $\pi$ is a central extension).
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an explicit open problem in the Loos–Neher program on Steinberg groups for root-graded Jordan pairs. Centrality (and central closedness) of the canonical map St(V,R) → PE(V) is established in the Loos–Neher monograph under restrictive hypotheses (e.g., specific root systems, sufficient rank, or extra assumptions on V), but a general sufficient-condition theorem for arbitrary irreducible finite-rank 3-graded root systems is not available in the public literature, and the introductory survey explicitly lists this as an open problem. No subsequent publication resolving it in full generality was located.

status_evidence.title: Steinberg groups for Jordan pairs – an introduction with open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Introduction with open problems concerning Steinberg groups associated to root-graded Jordan pairs, including centrality of the kernel of the canonical map to the projective elementary group.
status_evidence.claim: The centrality of Ker(pi) for finite-rank irreducible root systems is listed among the open problems in this program.

status_evidence.title: Steinberg Groups For Root Graded Jordan Pairs (Loos–Neher monograph chapter)
status_evidence.snippet: The main focus is the definition of the Steinberg group of a root graded Jordan pair by a small set of relations, and its central closedness.
status_evidence.claim: Central closedness/centrality of the kernel is proved only under specific structural assumptions, leaving the general sufficient-conditions question unresolved.
